visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a black sleeveless top, sits in a bright indoor room. A logo for DRX Dermatology Clinic is in the upper left. She speaks directly to the camera with varied facial expressions. (2) The lighting dims slightly as a vignette effect is applied. The woman continues speaking, using expressive hand gestures. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom. (3) The woman moves into a meditative posture, with hands framing her head, and the text '聖人MODE' appears. The background is a neutral wall. (4) The vignette disappears, and the woman resumes a high-energy explanation. She points and counts with her fingers, while hashtags related to skin conditions like acne and rosacea appear in the center. (5) The woman continues her detailed monologue, her hand movements reflecting her speech pattern. Various medical-related text overlays appear and disappear frequently. (6) The vignette returns as '不聖人MODE' is displayed. The woman's expression becomes more assertive and slightly frustrated for comedic effect. (7) A final graphic slide appears on a white background, showing the clinic logo, contact details, LINE account, and physical addresses.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Subtitle]: 之前有脆留留言說. (2) [Slogan]: 美上美看診SOP. [Subtitle]: 來美上美看診的SOP 就是口服A酸速立達跟一代A酸. (3) [Subtitle]: 那我要生氣了 來美上美看診的病人就是. (4) [Variety]: #青春痘的病人 #酒糟的病人. [Subtitle]: 青春痘的病人 酒糟的病人. (5) [Subtitle]: 那請問一下你叫我不要開那個 我要開什麼啦!!!. (6) [Variety]: 聖人MODE. [Subtitle]: 好我用禪修的方式跟他講. (7) [Subtitle]: 因為來美上美看診的病人 他就是一些. (8) [Variety]: #痘痘 #毛孔粗大 #酒糟 #長滿粉刺. [Subtitle]: 痘痘 毛孔粗大 酒糟 然後長滿粉刺的. (9) [Subtitle]: 他們是真的病人 並不是醫美的客人. (10) [Subtitle]: 他的皮膚呢 他就是需要控油. (11) [Subtitle]: 什麼東西控油最有效? 口服A酸. (12) [Subtitle]: 那他今天臉長滿了粉刺 他需要什麼藥. (13) [Slogan]: 外用A酸或A醇. [Subtitle]: 外用A酸或是A醇. (14) [Subtitle]: 臉上長滿蠕形蟎蟲讓他乾燥跟粗糙. (15) [Subtitle]: 請問一下我要不要殺蟲? 我當然就是殺蟲!. (16) [Subtitle]: 並不是所有人都需要這個東西. (17) [Subtitle]: 就好像我們去看感冒 你知道感冒藥就是那幾個藥而已嗎?. (18) [Variety]: #抗發炎藥 #退燒藥 #抗組織胺. [Subtitle]: 抗發炎藥 退燒藥 抗組織胺 這三個. (19) [Subtitle]: 偶爾因為發炎 他就給你一點點類固醇. (20) [Subtitle]: 他也不會給你一些抗病毒藥 因為我們也不知道是什麼病毒. (21) [Subtitle]: 永遠都是三個藥. (22) [Variety]: 不聖人MODE. [Subtitle]: 那你怎麼可以抱怨 來美上美就是開這個. (23) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.
